abstraction: #import <Metal/Metal.h> and nccl.h (id<MTLBuffer>, ncclMeshBuffer, ncclMeshAccess, ncclMeshPageTable_t)
handles: lets the layout interface name Metal buffers and the interface's (buffer, offset) types beside its element relations.
replacement: the layout interface imports only the page-map types (virtual page, physical page index, layout); Metal and pointer-bearing nccl.h types move to the final lowering.

abstraction: #import metal-recording.h: Metal.h, nccl.h, struct MetalReach{id<MTLBuffer>, offset, length} and the MetalView* emitters
handles: lets the layout implementation build Metal byte reaches and emit index source beside its element algebra.
replacement: the layout implementation imports only the page-map types; reaches and emission move to the final lowering, which takes the specialized page map.

abstraction: emitted Metal source with div and mod by layout extents, select and min/max over long(i)
handles: turns a layout's index terms into kernel text so the kernel finds each element's storage position.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table; only an affine piece, its base dereferenced from the page table, reaches kernel text.
note: every declaration emitter below reaches kernel text through this function

abstraction: thread-local cache keyed by the expression object's address (held != expression)
handles: keeps one compiled index program per expression so a layout's runs do not recompile it.
replacement: key the compiled program by the layout's own identity (its value or an ordinal), never by an object's host address.

abstraction: emitted 'inline long name(long storage) { long i = storage - low; return ...; }': the inverse of the source layout composed with the physical layout, evaluated per access
handles: maps a frontend's declared storage index to the placed page position inside the kernel.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: compose the inverse with the page map at preparation and emit the result as pointer literals or base + affine offset from the page table.

abstraction: origin: 'a separately declared pointer base, in this layout's scalar units'; emitted address expressions
handles: lets a binding's index source be written relative to a pointer base the caller picked.
replacement: specialization at final lowering: the base is the page table's dereferenced page literal; the layout interface takes no pointer base.

abstraction: layouts 'in bytes' and 'a scalar pointer' at the binding boundary
handles: lets a frontend's storage index and a byte-typed scalar pointer be declared through the layout.
replacement: composition of the frontend's index layout with the page map in element or page units; bytes and the pointer type appear only in final lowering.

abstraction: id<MTLBuffer> buffer and a byte base handed to a layout
handles: lets a layout declare its accesses for the dependency schedule as byte ranges of a Metal buffer.
replacement: image of the composed page map (the virtual and physical pages a use touches); hazards by intersection of images.

abstraction: properties id<MTLBuffer> buffer and origin (byte offset); +storage:(id<MTLBuffer>), +host:(const void *)
handles: gives placement a page-table object that also carries the Metal buffer, a byte origin and a pointer entry point.
replacement: a page operand carries the page table and page geometry only; the allocator hands it out with the lease, and the Metal buffer and origin are resolved at final lowering.

abstraction: MetalViewMappedIndexDeclaration: emitted mesh_index with (long(i) / divisor) % extent, map lookups and coordinate expressions, relative to a pointer base origin
handles: gives a kernel each element's storage position for a mapped or composed view.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table; non-affine views lowered to per-piece affine bindings, not per-access div/mod.

abstraction: MetalViewIndexConstants: function constants for a mixed-radix index (count, divisor, stride per axis) the kernel evaluates with div/mod at run time
handles: lets one compiled kernel serve strided views by passing their axes as function constants.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: base + affine offset from the page table; per-axis div/mod only where the view is not one affine piece, unrolled by the lowering.

abstraction: MetalViewPositionDeclaration: emitted mesh_position<B>(i) through mesh_index<0>
handles: emits an index-valued relation as arithmetic the kernel evaluates per position.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: the positions' runs as literal page indices or affine pieces.
note: where the positions are payload values rather than storage addresses this is data compute and not a violation

abstraction: emitted mesh_storage_N (TensorStorageDeclaration)
handles: lets a kernel translate a frontend storage index into the placed position at run time.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: compose the frontend index with the page map at preparation; emit pointer literals or base + affine offset.

abstraction: layouts in bytes; emitted mesh_storage_bytes_N and mesh_storage_N(i) = mesh_storage_bytes_N(i * width) / width
handles: lets a scalar pointer of one element width index storage placed in bytes.
replacement: specialize at final lowering: pointer literal or base + affine offset from the page table, typed at the boundary; no byte layout in the chooser.

abstraction: MetalReach{id<MTLBuffer> buffer, base + offset*bytes, length}; strides and maps scaled to bytes
handles: declares the byte ranges of a Metal buffer a use reads or writes, for the dependency schedule's hazards.
replacement: image of the use's composed page map; hazards as intersection of images (preimage gives the logical positions), no buffer or byte base.

abstraction: ncclMeshPageTableBinding -> ncclMeshBuffer{buffer, offset}; _buffer = binding.buffer, _origin = binding.offset
handles: binds the page operand to the Metal buffer over its pages and remembers the byte origin of its view.
replacement: specialization at final lowering: page index -> (region Metal buffer, page x page bytes); the page operand holds no buffer or origin.

abstraction: ncclMeshPageTableCreate(const void *address); _origin = address - _buffer.contents
handles: turns a frontend host pointer into a page table and the pointer's byte offset inside its Metal buffer.
replacement: inverse taken once at the interface: the allocator returns the page table with the lease; no contents arithmetic in the chooser.

abstraction: buffer.contents of an id<MTLBuffer>
handles: accepts a Metal buffer as a page operand by reading its host address.
replacement: inverse taken once at the interface: a Metal buffer over a lease is named by its page table, never by contents.

abstraction: backing pages expanded to region byte positions (components:pageBytes) and the layout rebased onto them
handles: expresses an operand's elements as physical region byte positions so placement follows scattered pages.
replacement: composition of the layout with the invocation -> (virtual page -> physical page) map in page units; physical bytes only at final lowering.

abstraction: layout shifted by _origin / bytes (the view's byte offset in its Metal buffer)
handles: places a layout at the view's offset inside the Metal buffer that binds it.
replacement: specialization at final lowering: the view's base is the dereferenced first page; the chooser's layout starts at virtual page 0.

abstraction: #import mesh-tensor-layout.h, which brings Metal.h and nccl.h (id<MTLBuffer>, ncclMeshBuffer, void *) into the relation algebra
handles: reuses the layout type in the isl relation module; the pointer-bearing types come with it.
replacement: the relation module imports the page-map layout type alone; no Metal or pointer-bearing header reaches it.
note: the relation algebra itself (compose, inverse, preimage, quotient, closure) is the target model's and has no other violation
